title: Project 25 (P25)
short: Project 25 (P25 or APCO-25) is a trunked radio standard developed by The Association of Public Safety Communications Officials International (APCO-25) for use with public safety organizations around the world.
desc:
- Not to be confused with Yaesu [C4FM](https://www.sigidwiki.com/wiki/Yaesu_System_Fusion)*

**Project 25 (P25 or APCO-25)** is a trunked radio standard developed by The Association of Public Safety Communications Officials International (APCO-25) for use with public safety organizations around the world. P25 supports encrypted voice.
